name: the bundled priority example
sentence: This network uses priority service at S1. Capacity planning does not model that, and would answer for a different network. Replicated Simulation models it, and so does the exact single-station formula where it applies.

the bundled rush-hour example
sentence: This network uses a time-varying arrival rate at Src1. Capacity planning does not model that, and would answer for a different network. A network whose arrival rate changes in time has no single steady state: the Transient view computes how it moves, and Run ▸ Animate shows it.

name: all three at once
sentence: This network uses priority service at S1, S2 and batch arrivals at Src1 and a time-varying arrival rate at Src1. Capacity planning does not model that, and would answer for a different network. A network whose arrival rate changes in time has no single steady state: the Transient view computes how it moves, and Run ▸ Animate shows it.

name: a discipline on a buffer and a batch law on a station are not uses of the features
a closed network with a priority station is told it is closed first
sentence: This is a closed network: a fixed number of customers circulates and nothing arrives from outside. Capacity planning covers open networks.
